# Feasible runtime lower bounds on Ubuntu CPython. Test/build tools are not pinned.
# SciPy 1.11.0 is yanked; 1.11.2 supplies Python 3.12 wheels.
# Python 3.13 requires newer compiled dependencies; see RELEASE_CLOSEOUT.md.
numpy==1.26.0; python_version < '3.13'
numpy==2.1.0; python_version >= '3.13'
scipy==1.11.1; python_version < '3.12'
scipy==1.11.2; python_version == '3.12'
scipy==1.14.1; python_version >= '3.13'
pandas==2.0.0; python_version < '3.12'
pandas==2.1.1; python_version == '3.12'
pandas==2.2.3; python_version >= '3.13'
numba==0.59.0; python_version < '3.13'
numba==0.61.0; python_version >= '3.13'
joblib==1.3.0
threadpoolctl==3.2.0
